name: machine-monitor
description: A status line with CPU load, GPU use, swap and free disk; refuses heavy Bash jobs (renders, ffmpeg, Blender) while the machine is overloaded; warns when disk runs low or temp folders grow.

loadLimit.title: Load limit
loadLimit.description: Heavy Bash jobs are refused while the 1-minute load average is over this. Default 20

freeGbWarn.title: Low disk warning (GB free)
freeGbWarn.description: Warn when a watched path has less free space than this. Default 20

tempGbWarn.title: Temp size warning (GB)
tempGbWarn.description: Warn when the temp folders add up to more than this. Default 20

configFile.title: Config file
configFile.description: JSON file with heavyPatterns, watchPaths and tempGlobs. Default ~/.claude-mods/machine-monitor.json
